**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall charge or volume restriction on Sparkling:

- **§11 Fees** is a bare pay-as-set-out-in-the-Fee-Schedule obligation, with no committed spend.
- **§10 Maintenance** runs on a *renewable one-year term* — no multi-year maintenance lock-in.
- **§2 Grant of Licence** triggers additional fees only if we elect to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations (ordered services, not a commitment).
- **§3 Restrictions on Use** are ordinary licence-scope limits (copying, sublicensing, reverse engineering) rather than caps on our purchasing or usage volumes.
- **§17(b)** lets Sparkling terminate at any time on 90 days' notice, so no take-or-pay exposure could accrue without an exit.

This sits at the **preferred** position (fees for usage or ordered services only). The one residual point, noted in the rationale rather than flagged: pricing detail lives in Schedule "A" (Fee Schedule), which is not reproduced in the body — worth confirming on execution that it contains no committed licence counts or minimum maintenance years.
